selection: All nine attempts; complete method/status records for each selected observation stream, selected response/effect records, source line numbers (one-based), policy chronology and abstention identity proofs. Original files unchanged. No raw cluster dumps or credential values included.

semantics.webhook_offered: In resumed result.json, true is inherited event history; use observation_only plus HTTP records to establish GET-only phase.
semantics.counts: One original event per attempt; parallel/previous reads and fresh smoke checks are not additional repetitions.
semantics.convergence: Composite healthy revision convergence, not exact Pod Ready transition.
semantics.same_sample: Pending completion and parallel convergence use the same six attempts.
semantics.canonical_identity_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=true.
semantics.preparation_result: Initial pending result.success=false and verdict=pending describe intentional pre-restoration preparation, not a failed evaluation attempt.

journal.clock_note: elapsed_seconds are comparable only for matching process_id. Later cleanup is not a policy restoration.

parallel_signals.clock: Same attempt runtime monotonic origin as policy journal; HTTP and snapshot endpoints include query/polling delay.
